scheme_name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided there for more than 10 years at the time of application
Applicant must be a poor and destitute woman
Household income must not exceed ₹4000 per month
Applicant must not be receiving any other government assistance or pension
Beneficiary must inform the Director of Social Welfare about any change of address or employment status within 15 days
Failure to inform within 15 days may lead to recovery of the allowance paid
benefits_summary: An allowance of ₹2500 per month is provided, paid directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
